poll.source_locator: Release paragraph 2: 'Ashley Moody leads Angie Nixon 51.6% to 44.7% when undecideds are leaned.'
poll.notes: The release does not say which population the headline figure uses; the methodology lists 1,201 RV and 1,129 LV, and Big Data Poll's convention is LV toplines, so recorded LV with n=1,129 (inference, flagged). Wikipedia lists 1,067 LV, 52/45, Gillespie 4; those figures are not on the release (crosstabs on MarketSight, not read). Release headline misnames Nixon as 'Angie Craig'. other/undecided not stated. Sponsor statement: publicly conducted surveys crowdfunded via the Public Polling Project, not funded by any candidate or committee. Sponsor per the release (1776 Law Center); class per big-data-poll majority precedent (PARTISAN_PUBLIC, R). LV is inferred: the release does not label the headline population.

pollster.weighting_quote: Results were weighted for sex, age, race and ethnicity, education, and geography.
pollster.mode: mixed: online (Lucid/CINT, ~40%) and live-agent phone, P2P SMS and text-to-online from the L2 voter file (~60%)
